en: The image shows a hand-colored view of a small town at the foot of a mountain. The main focus is a prominent Romanesque-style church with a tall bell tower, cross-topped spires, and arched windows. The church is situated near a riverbank, with several houses and a rocky hillside in the background. Printed text in red appears on the right, identifying the location and subject of the image, accompanied by handwritten script.
